says: Sonnet builds alone; Sonnet repairs in the same session (graph-loop today)

findings: src/tools.js accepts fire({"tank":"__proto__"}), creates a shell with invalid coordinates and writes cooldown and shot fields onto Object.prototype instead of returning an error.
src/sim.js pushes a stationary computer instead of stopping at contact: with AI off, computer at (17,0) and player at (18.8,2) heading 270, five W-held steps displace the computer.

src/sim.js checks shell collisions only at step endpoints, so firing from the default player position misses a computer at (0.225,1.449), leaving it at 100 health despite the shell touching it between steps.
src/game.js:43 and src/sim.js:44–46 let a player at (-10.2,-5.1), heading 0, fire through the inner wall without bouncing: after 0.2 seconds the shell reaches (-5.6,-5.1) with bounces=0.
src/sim.js:54 ignores exact shell–tank contact because it uses strict < instead of <=: firing along z=0 at a computer tank placed at (0,1.45) leaves its health at 100 despite the shell touching it.
src/sim.js checks wall collisions only at shell endpoints, so firing from (-5.558629, -6.091371) at heading 135 misses a genuine corner contact during the first step and leaves bounces at 0.
src/sim.js ignores wall overlaps with zero normal velocity: firing from (-10.2, -4.9) at heading 0 sends the shell through the inner wall's edge without registering a bounce.
src/main.js discards elapsed time beyond 100 ms per frame, so slow frames advance the unpaused game less than real time requires.

final.why: Fix what the reviewer refused (REJECT): src/sim.js checks wall collisions only at shell endpoints, so firing from (-5.558629, -6.091371) at heading 135 misses a genuine corner contact during the first step and leaves bounces at 0.; src/sim.js ignores wall overlaps with zero normal velocity: firing from (-10.2, -4.9) at heading 0 sends the shell through the inner wall's edge without registering a bounce.; src/main.js discards elapsed time beyond 100 ms per frame, so slow frames advance the unpaused game less than real time requires.
